title: Defining M-theory beyond perturbation theory
bottleneck: M-theory is conjectured to be the non-perturbative completion unifying the five string theories through dualities, yet it has no fundamental definition independent of those perturbative limits. Matrix theory and AdS/CFT provide definitions only in specific backgrounds, not for the theory in general.
why_it_blocks: The supposed master theory of unification cannot be written down; every calculation is done in one of its low-energy corners, so claims about M-theory's predictions rest on extrapolations across uncharted duality territory.
current_state: BFSS matrix theory defines M-theory in light-front coordinates and AdS/CFT defines it in anti-de Sitter backgrounds, but a background-independent formulation remains the field's most wanted missing piece. Matrix theory captures discrete light-cone quantization and AdS/CFT captures specific backgrounds, but a background-independent definition of M-theory does not exist.
